keyPoints.en: Tin (Larut, Kinta) and rubber (promoted by H.N. Ridley) drove the economy.
keyPoints.bm: Bijih timah (Larut, Kinta) dan getah (dipromosi oleh H.N. Ridley) memacu ekonomi.

keyPoints.en: Infrastructure linked mines and estates to ports — first railway Taiping–Port Weld (1885).
keyPoints.bm: Infrastruktur menghubungkan lombong dan ladang ke pelabuhan — landasan pertama Taiping–Port Weld (1885).

keyPoints.en: Dual economy and uneven development (west coast vs east coast).
keyPoints.bm: Ekonomi dualisme dan pembangunan tidak seimbang (pantai barat lawan pantai timur).

keyPoints.en: Chinese (mines, trade) and Indian (estates, kangani system) immigration → plural society.
keyPoints.bm: Imigrasi Cina (lombong, perniagaan) dan India (ladang, sistem kangani) → masyarakat majmuk.

keyPoints.en: Vernacular schools (Malay, Chinese, Tamil) and English schools; MCKK (1905), SITC (1922).
keyPoints.bm: Sekolah vernakular (Melayu, Cina, Tamil) dan sekolah Inggeris; MCKK (1905), SITC (1922).

keyPoints.en: Towns grew; ethnic groups were linked to different jobs and areas — a challenge for unity.
keyPoints.bm: Bandar berkembang; kaum dikaitkan dengan pekerjaan dan kawasan berbeza — cabaran kepada perpaduan.
